changes.comment: A native install or update that waits for the rushx scripts that the daemon runs now says so, for example "waiting for 1 running rushx script to finish, since this command restarts the daemon (PID 41), which would end it", on a pipe too. A failed command's agent summary line no longer ends with the queue position at which it once waited. The cancellation notices of rushx-client begin with "rushx-client:".
